title: Closure after removing a matched pair
statement: Let a complete multipartite graph have vertex set consisting of $q$ parts with $k$ vertices each, and let it have a perfect matching. If a finite set of vertices contains the matching partner of each of its vertices, then after removing a vertex in that set and its matching partner, the remaining set still contains the matching partner of each of its vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching of the complete multipartite graph
A finite set closed under taking matching partners
A vertex belonging to that set
